GRADE 6 SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Time: 30 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Levers as simple machines in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify common levers used in day- to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Levers as simple machines completely.
   C. Levers as simple machines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Levers as simple machines.

2. About Levers as simple machines around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe parts of a lever as used in making work easier,
   B. Learners should ignore Levers as simple machines completely.
   C. Levers as simple machines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Levers as simple machines.

3. About Levers as simple machines in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. classify levers into the three classes,
   B. Learners should ignore Levers as simple machines completely.
   C. Levers as simple machines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Levers as simple machines.

5. About Slopes as simple machines in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify types of slopes used as simple machines,
   B. Learners should ignore Slopes as simple machines completely.
   C. Slopes as simple machines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Slopes as simple machines.

6. About Slopes as simple machines around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate how a slope makes work easier in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Slopes as simple machines completely.
   C. Slopes as simple machines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Slopes as simple machines.

7. About Slopes as simple machines in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify types of slopes used as simple machines,
   B. Learners should ignore Slopes as simple machines completely.
   C. Slopes as simple machines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Slopes as simple machines.

9. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

10. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

11. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

12. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

SECTION B: Short Answers
